steps.note: Start a multi-stage project create flow so an RFQ stage can be published and converted.
Provide the required event title for publishing.
Create an RFQ-only event, which is the source state for conversion.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Add the required participant so the event can be published.
Publish the RFQ so Convert to Auction becomes available.
Confirm the source RFQ reached a published project page.
Perform the conversion action whose activity entry is under test.
Reopen this plan's original event page to inspect its recorded activity.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Assert that the activity drawer contains the conversion entry.
